items.evidence: RTM: E2E VERIFIED, offline commit+sync on real PostgreSQL. CORE-ONE-LANE (prove the core on one lane): proving the spine end-to-end through the REAL lane record — not a hand-built cloud-shaped one — surfaced a real break: the lane writes its sale to disk as {id,total,tender.amount.minor} with no packVersion, the cloud /v1/sales reads {saleId,totalMinor,packVersion,amountMinor}, and the outbox carried the disk record verbatim, so every rung sale was refused 400 and dead-lettered — money in the drawer, no record in the cloud (the prior DB-gated 'reaches the cloud' gate missed it because it fed the edge node a pre-mapped cloud-shaped record and skips without DATABASE_URL). Fixed with a translation at the edge sync boundary (edge/store-edge/src/cloud-sale.ts toCloudSale, stamping packVersion from the pack the edge holds), applied at both enqueue sites (createEdgeNode.commit + startEdge boot-restore). New ALWAYS-ON in-memory E2E rings the sale the way the lane actually does and drives the real edge+outbox+SyncAgent+httpTransport+cloud surface: offline-first (disk+queue, cloud untouched) -> banked -> owner dashboard shows the takings -> idempotent resend no double-count; plus a regression guard that the raw till record is still refused 400 while the translated one banks. tests/e2e/core-one-lane.test.ts, tests/unit/edge-cloud-sale.test.ts. HONEST SCOPE: proves ONE lane's happy path + offline + idempotency through the real wire; NOT UAT, NOT production.

Trace confirmed this route is a DIRECT desk/online guard (no offline refund syncs through it today — ReturnAccepted has no cloud route), so rejecting a bad approver before money moves is safe and does not touch offline-first; the offline capture is unchanged. tests/integration/returns-guard-the-refund.test.ts rewritten (every refund needs a verified approver at the 0 default; a cashier/unprovisioned approver refused; the threshold owner-settable). approver-lacks-authority reconciles AND flags a visible §28 exception; no-receipt kept for a person; waits out an outage then reconciles) + 4 transport unit tests. **Slice 2b (the edge-bootstrap drain wire) is now WIRED (M13-FR-01, §31, P-01):** createEdgeNode gains commitReturn(returnId, record) — the mirror of commit: durably writes the refund to the edge's OWN returns.log (never the sale log) and enqueues ReturnAccepted into a SEPARATE returns outbox, translated by toCloudReturn (edge/store-edge/src/cloud-return.ts, mirror of toCloudSale;
